messages:
Nora Kim: quick PR to add Seoul region notes + a tiny migration snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459
Ethan Li: can you include a short Node and curl example and call out quota/rate-limit per region?
Nora Kim: added Node + curl. Node snippet:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'ap-northeast-2' });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Summarize: meeting notes' });
```
Priya Rao: wording suggestion: say "Hosted regional endpoints process and store data in the selected region for standard accounts." add: "For contractual residency, contact legal."
legal-bot: Please include DPA link: https://redwood.ai/compliance/dpa and contact legal@redwood.ai for custom residency agreements. Avoid absolutes about data movement.
docs-ci: Link-check passed 12/12. Replaced external map with /assets/region-matrix.png per suggestion.
Nora Kim: added note about rate limits being per-region and a one-line migration curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ap-northeast-2.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi"}'
```
Ethan Li: LGTM, will merge after legal confirms phrasing. :+1:
